WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT City, COUNT(*) as count
  FROM Employee
  WHERE City IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY City
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(count) as avg_value
  FROM city_counts
),
kept AS (
  SELECT cc.count, ac.avg_value
  FROM city_counts cc
  CROSS JOIN avg_count ac
  WHERE ac.avg_value IS NOT NULL
    AND cc.count > ac.avg_value
)
SELECT 
  AVG(count) as avg_employee_count,
  AVG(count - avg_value) as avg_difference
FROM kept
